fatal_failures: the exact public static ComputeMarginCall(Money, Money, CsaElections) entry point or required public support types are absent
the return case is emitted as DELIVERY or is rounded up to 1.8m
the implementation passes a monetary calculation through double or float
the implementation invents a CDM 7.0.0 field, edits generated model code, or silently ignores mixed currencies

criteria.description: Expose the exact calculator contract and a caller-visible direction plus Money magnitude.
checks: Compile and invoke benchmark.margin.MarginCallCalculator.ComputeMarginCall(Money, Money, CsaElections) directly.
Direction contains DELIVERY, RETURN, and NONE; result amount is a non-null, non-negative CDM Money magnitude.

criteria.description: Calculate the clean 12.3m versus 10m delivery case.
checks: Return DELIVERY GBP 2.3m for exposure 12.3m, threshold 10m, posted/IA zero, and MTA 500k.
An already exact 100k multiple is not changed.

criteria.description: Suppress a raw amount strictly below MTA.
checks: Return NONE and zero for a 400k raw delta under a 500k MTA.
Do not round the 400k into an actionable demand before applying MTA.

criteria.description: Flip direction and round the return magnitude down.
checks: For credit support 3.27m and posted 5m, return Direction.RETURN.
Round the 1.73m return down to 1.7m, not up to 1.8m.
Expose 1.7m as a non-negative magnitude rather than a signed Money value.

criteria.description: Implement the stated CSA formula, including additive independent amount.
checks: Compute max(0, exposure - threshold) before adding independent amount.
An exposure below threshold with a positive IA can still create a delivery.
A negative exposure never makes the pre-IA exposure component negative.

criteria.description: Apply MTA to the absolute raw delta with the correct strict boundary.
checks: A raw delta exactly equal to MTA remains actionable.
The same strict boundary applies to returns.
A zero delta returns NONE even when MTA is zero.

criteria.description: Use the separate CDM delivery and return rounding elections exactly.
checks: Delivery uses deliveryAmount and deliveryDirection; return uses returnAmount and returnDirection.
Distinct delivery and return increments are not conflated.
UP behaves as ceiling and DOWN as floor on non-negative magnitudes; exact multiples remain exact.
No path uses Math.round, setScale as a substitute for increment rounding, double, or float.

criteria.description: Use CDM 7.0.0 Money and CollateralRounding without parallel model copies.
checks: Read Money.value and UnitType.currency through the generated API and build the output as cdm.observable.asset.Money.
Require exposure, posted collateral, threshold, MTA, IA, and CollateralRounding to use the same currency.
Preserve the base currency in both actionable and zero results.

criteria.description: Fail clearly on invalid resolved inputs and remain side-effect free.
checks: Reject null or incomplete values, negative posted/threshold/MTA/IA, and non-positive selected rounding increments.
Do not mutate any Money, UnitType, CollateralRounding, or elections input.
Do not wire a full Rosetta runtime or whole-agreement qualification path that this application-owned calculation does not invoke.

criteria.description: Tests exercise the exact public method and materially prove the legal asymmetry.
checks: Authored tests invoke the exact public method for all three required cases.
The return test explicitly rejects DELIVERY and 1.8m; inputs use exact BigDecimal string literals.
